sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, as listed by Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles. Hidden flags are from Exophase (via Planet GTA 6). How-to facts are from PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide, written here in our own words, never copied.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops with the last one. There is no shortcut: finish the story, work the roadmap in order, and the platinum is the final reward. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the first mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission. Keep a manual save before the finale: the game has no mission replay and 15 manual save slots. It cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, says PowerPyx. After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion, not a literal 100%: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all 15 Target Decks, all 8 bank jobs and all 39 gang operations. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (the 100% checklist needs 300). Four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track them on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, and in Progress, Activities, Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you have done. Most come naturally during the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx lists every range location and all 42 gold medals. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total). PowerPyx lists all 14 locations. Drone race wins also count toward the race activity type.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists all 40 unique race locations. Race wins also count toward the race activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are 4: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game to pop it; you do not need every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams. He marks treasure chests on the map; dive for them with the metal detector and bring them back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable. Track it in Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline unlocks after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) are confirmed, and more are still being found. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. All strands stay available in free-roam after the story; check your count in the trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, starts after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list (tracked under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List); he marks some in fixed spots and the rest can be stolen off the street. Doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. Available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with Jason and Lucia together at a spot counts +2. Track them in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, is only offered in Chapter 1 (the morning after Down to Earth) and is gone after that chapter. It is not confirmed whether it counts toward the 18, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline, Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him; the first quest gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69. Still available after the story. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so complete his hunts and it comes.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists all 18 card set locations. Card sets are one of the collectible types that the 100% checklist only partly requires, so hunt the sets, not every card.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). Any 100 count: the known pools are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scanning is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way). View them under Progress, Challenges. Many complete naturally; pick the easiest remaining ones late. PowerPyx lists all 80 challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. Available after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Easiest escape: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is and while robbing the 8 bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level (stay in the flashing red and blue wanted state, not the red heat level). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan vehicles: just stand by a busy road and scan everything passing. You do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Track them in Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming: it slows time and drains the purple focus bar). Buff focus first with food, drink, a shower or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it, and wear body armor. Best targets are criminals at Gang Operations: the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (not one on the airfield). The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in and shoot until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, to unlock the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape (the 100% checklist needs all 8). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast bike, then switch cars to break the heat. Up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map: explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Fastest in a plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx has a plane-and-route guide for unfogging fast.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way). Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track per-gang counts in Progress, Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, with no confirmed trigger yet. The description points at a cocktail with an ocean view, so try ordering a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach. Check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts: a reference to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). It unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it in Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength (heart icon). Available after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out together (hold Right, press Triangle to call your partner): while one trains, the other completes training automatically. Buy a fitness club membership or work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count). Turn on notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears when an action counts. Ranks run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent: avoid it, cops shoot on sight). It comes passively from robberies and fights; if it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Try revisiting the Payday Loans store and its missions. Check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. Look for strange happenings and UFO-related quests as they are found. Check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by). Try melee attacks from a moving bike. Check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (it adds up across robberies, not all at once). First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check, to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). Bank vaults alone can give up to $205,000 in one robbery, once they unlock after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Fastest on the most expensive things: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 mod shops, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages unlock for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver: buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register; later, cars with Standard Trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
